title: The garage from the alley, the lamp lit
logline: The garage window from the alley at night, the green lamp's shape visible inside for once, lit, a page under it, the shape of a man. Eleven days before the ridge stops. The page watches the work from outside.

panels.composition: A garage's small window from a dark alley at night with a green swing-arm lamp visible inside, lit, and the shape of a man bent at a table beneath it.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a garage's small window seen from a dark alley at night with a green swing-arm lamp visible inside lit over the shape of a man bent at a table, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
